beats.label: S1 · Landing in Paris
beats.text: Emily moves from Chicago to a Paris marketing job she can't do in French; her new boss Sylvie freezes her out and colleagues nickname her la plouc.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Emily's outsider position at Savoir, which every workplace beat this season is measured against.

beats.label: S1 · Going viral
beats.text: A campaign for a menopause lubricant wins Emily her first credibility at Savoir and turns @emilyinparis into an account clients start chasing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Gives Emily the leverage that lets her make demands of Sylvie and start pulling clients like Cadault and Champère.

beats.label: S1 · The neighbour downstairs
beats.text: Emily kisses her downstairs neighbour Gabriel at his restaurant; leaving, she runs into Camille, a new French friend who reveals Gabriel is her boyfriend.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the triangle that drives essentially every personal beat for the next four seasons.

beats.label: S1 · Château weekend
beats.text: A weekend at Camille's family château ends with Emily sleeping with Camille's teenage brother while pitching to run the family champagne account.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks Emily into a business tie with Camille's family at the exact moment their friendship is fragile, keeping them entangled.

beats.label: S1 · Saving Pierre Cadault
beats.text: Emily rescues Pierre Cadault from cancelling his Fashion Week show, making Savoir the toast of Paris and drawing his nephew Mathieu into a courtship.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cements Pierre as Savoir's marquee client and puts Mathieu in place as Emily's rival love interest to open S2.

beats.label: S1 · Antoine's investment
beats.text: Believing Gabriel is leaving Paris for good, Emily sleeps with him — then Antoine invests in his restaurant and he stays right below her apartment.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The one-night stand that Camille doesn't know about is the ticking bomb of S2, and Gabriel's continued proximity is what lets it detonate.

cliffhanger.text: Emily has slept with her closest Paris friend's boyfriend on what was supposed to be his last night in the city — but Antoine's investment has just kept Gabriel downstairs. Camille suspects nothing, and Mathieu Cadault is quietly courting Emily.
questions: Will Camille find out about Emily and Gabriel?
Can Emily and Gabriel live in the same building without slipping again?
Does Emily choose Mathieu, Gabriel, or the boyfriend she left behind in Chicago?

characters.name: Emily Cooper
characters.line: American marketing associate at Savoir, on a one-year assignment in Paris; secretly slept with her best friend's boyfriend the night before Antoine's investment.

characters.name: Sylvie Grateau
characters.line: Emily's icy boss at Savoir, having a long-running affair with client Antoine.

characters.name: Gabriel
characters.line: French chef and Emily's downstairs neighbour; Camille's boyfriend, restaurant now funded by Antoine.

characters.name: Camille
characters.line: Gallery owner and Emily's closest friend in Paris; entirely unaware Emily has slept with Gabriel.

characters.name: Mindy Chen
characters.line: Emily's new roommate; a Chinese heiress hiding as a nanny turned drag-bar singer.

characters.name: Antoine Lambert
characters.line: Perfume magnate, Sylvie's married lover and — as of the finale — Gabriel's restaurant investor.

characters.name: Mathieu Cadault
characters.line: Pierre Cadault's nephew, freshly courting Emily after she saved the Fashion Week show.

characters.name: Pierre Cadault
characters.line: Haute couturier and Savoir's most prestigious client, personally loyal to Emily after her stunt saved him.

beats.label: S2 · St Tropez unravels
beats.text: Bound for St Tropez with Mathieu, Emily is overheard confessing she slept with Gabriel; Mathieu gets off the train and she goes on with Camille and Mindy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The first outsider learns about Emily and Gabriel, and the season's countdown to Camille finding out begins here.

beats.label: S2 · The frying pan
beats.text: At Emily's birthday dinner Camille spots Gabriel's engraved pan in her kitchen, pieces the affair together, and denounces Emily as a turncoat in front of everyone.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The reveal that reshapes every relationship for the rest of the series.

beats.label: S2 · The pact and Alfie
beats.text: Emily and Camille make a pact at the Eiffel Tower never to touch Gabriel; Emily starts dating Alfie, a bored British banker from her French class.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the pact whose eventual breach becomes the S3 finale, and Alfie, who will define Emily's romantic life for two seasons.

beats.label: S2 · Madeline lands
beats.text: Emily's Chicago boss Madeline flies in pregnant to audit Savoir, uncovers Sylvie's long affair with client Antoine, and moves to gut the office.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts a new authority above Sylvie and detonates the leadership crisis that ends the season.

beats.label: S2 · Coup at Versailles
beats.text: At Pierre Cadault's Versailles show Pierre fires Savoir; Sylvie and her whole team walk out to launch a new firm funded by Laurent selling his club stake.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The whole Savoir infrastructure Emily has been climbing collapses at once, forcing the S2 finale choice.

beats.label: S2 · Emily's choice
beats.text: Rather than fly back to Chicago with Madeline, Emily is asked to join Sylvie's new firm; downstairs, Gabriel and Camille quietly move back in together.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up both S3 opening dilemmas: Emily secretly working for two firms, and the reunited couple she has to live above.

cliffhanger.text: Sylvie's team has walked out of Savoir with Pierre Cadault in tow and wants Emily on board rather than back in Chicago with a pregnant Madeline. Meanwhile Gabriel and Camille have moved in together, one floor below Emily and Alfie.
questions: Does Emily stay in Paris with Sylvie or go home with Madeline?
What happens to Savoir now that its whole staff has quit?
Can Gabriel and Camille last with Emily still right upstairs?

characters.name: Emily Cooper
characters.line: Being pulled between joining Sylvie's new firm in Paris and returning to Chicago with Madeline; dating Alfie.

characters.name: Sylvie Grateau
characters.line: Has just quit Savoir with her whole team and Pierre Cadault, launching a new firm on Laurent's money.

characters.name: Gabriel
characters.line: Chef at Chez Levaux, quietly back together with Camille and living below Emily.

characters.name: Camille
characters.line: Reconciled with Gabriel, still guarded around Emily after publicly outing the affair.

characters.name: Alfie
characters.line: British banker in Paris, Emily's boyfriend, about to be recalled to London.

characters.name: Mindy Chen
characters.line: Emily's roommate, dating Benoit and singing in his band.

characters.name: Madeline Wheeler
characters.line: Emily's newly-postpartum Chicago boss, left running Savoir after her whole French team walked out.

characters.name: Antoine Lambert
characters.line: Perfume magnate whose affair with Sylvie has just been exposed by Madeline.

characters.name: Laurent Grateau
characters.line: Sylvie's husband, revealed at St Tropez; sold his club stake to fund her new firm.

beats.label: S3 · Working both sides
beats.text: Torn between Sylvie's new firm and Madeline at Savoir, Emily secretly works for both until Luc rats her out mid-pitch at the Eiffel Tower.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The impossible double-job is what forces Emily's eventual resignation and choice of Sylvie.

beats.label: S3 · Winning Alfie back
beats.text: Emily wins a departing Alfie back by singing to him at Mindy's Solstice gig; a non-compete clause meanwhile leaves Sylvie's new firm with almost no clients.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cements Alfie as Emily's real relationship of the season, whose eventual breakup is the finale's blow.

beats.label: S3 · Agence Grateau
beats.text: After Madeline sabotages the Savoir building to force them out, Emily resigns and joins Sylvie back at their old office as Agence Grateau.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The firm every subsequent workplace beat runs through is born here.

beats.label: S3 · Sofia and Nico
beats.text: Camille begins a secret affair with Greek artist Sofia at her gallery; Mindy meanwhile falls for Nicholas de Leon, heir to luxury conglomerate JVMA.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Sofia, who reroutes Camille's arc, and Nico, whose JVMA family drives the next two seasons of business plot.

beats.label: S3 · Pierre's fake death
beats.text: When JVMA plans to replace Pierre Cadault with his rival Gregory, Emily stages a fake-death stunt so Pierre can reappear at the launch and quit JVMA himself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens the direct hostility between Agence Grateau and JVMA that will define the next season's business war.

beats.label: S3 · Alfie sees it
beats.text: Emily helps engineer Gabriel's proposal to Camille; Alfie senses Emily's real feelings for Gabriel and breaks up with her rather than be a second choice.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Alfie's exit is what leaves Emily emotionally exposed when the wedding blows up hours later.

beats.label: S3 · Wedding and pregnancy
beats.text: At the altar Camille refuses her vows and outs Gabriel's love for Emily; afterwards Gabriel tells Emily that Camille only came back from Greece to reveal she is pregnant.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The two things the season leaves unresolved — Gabriel's public feelings and the pregnancy — are the whole engine of S4.

cliffhanger.text: Camille has publicly outed Gabriel's love for Emily at their own altar, Alfie has broken up with Emily suspecting exactly that, and Gabriel has just told Emily that Camille came back from Greece pregnant with his child.
questions: Will Gabriel choose Emily or the mother of his child?
Is Alfie really gone for good?
Do Camille and Sofia find their way back to each other?

characters.name: Emily Cooper
characters.line: At Agence Grateau, freshly dumped by Alfie, and the woman Gabriel has just publicly declared he loves.

characters.name: Sylvie Grateau
characters.line: Runs the newly-launched Agence Grateau from her old Savoir building.

characters.name: Gabriel
characters.line: Engaged to Camille and just learning she is pregnant; still in love with Emily.

characters.name: Camille
characters.line: Pregnant, has broken off her own wedding vows to out Gabriel's love for Emily, and has been sleeping with Sofia.

characters.name: Alfie
characters.line: Just broke up with Emily suspecting Gabriel; now working as Antoine's CFO.

characters.name: Mindy Chen
characters.line: Dating Nicholas, though Benoit has just entered a song of hers for Eurovision.

characters.name: Nicholas de Leon
characters.line: Heir to luxury conglomerate JVMA and Mindy's boyfriend.

characters.name: Sofia
characters.line: Greek artist from Camille's gallery, in love with Camille.

beats.label: S4 · Public breakup
beats.text: In front of a stadium crowd Alfie ends things with Emily on the jumbotron; the same morning Camille disappears from her own wedding.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kicks off the season by removing both of the couples Emily was living between at the S3 finale.

beats.label: S4 · Camille found
beats.text: Emily finds Camille in Greece with Sofia and brings her home; Camille tells Gabriel their pregnancy makes them a family whatever else is true.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reinstates Camille's hold on Gabriel and the pregnancy claim that governs every one of his decisions this season.

beats.label: S4 · JVMA exposé
beats.text: Sylvie publishes an exposé of JVMA chief Louis de Leon's harassment; the company is forced to push him out and Julien defects there briefly before crawling back.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The disgrace of Nico's family is the seed of his S5 break from JVMA and his father's money.

beats.label: S4 · Never pregnant
beats.text: A doctor confirms Camille was never pregnant; she chooses to hide it from Gabriel to keep him tied to her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The secret that makes Gabriel's later choice on the slopes a betrayal Emily can't forgive.

beats.label: S4 · Ski chalet
beats.text: On a Provençal ski trip Gabriel abandons Emily on the slopes to protect a still-'pregnant' Camille; an Italian stranger named Marcello Muratori helps Emily down instead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The choice ends Gabriel and Emily and simultaneously introduces the man who will move her to Rome.

beats.label: S4 · Rome with Marcello
beats.text: Emily breaks up with Gabriel for choosing Camille again and takes Marcello up on a trip to Rome, discovering he runs his family's cashmere house.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The trip that turns a chance meeting into the relationship carrying Emily into the next season.

beats.label: S4 · Rome office
beats.text: Sylvie opens an Agence Grateau office in Rome and installs Emily as manager; Gabriel earns a Michelin star and immediately asks Mindy where in Rome Emily is.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Relocates the entire show and sets up S5's parallel: Gabriel free and hunting for Emily, Emily building a life without him.

cliffhanger.text: Emily is running the new Agence Grateau office in Rome and touring the city on the back of Marcello's scooter, while a Michelin-starred, Camille-less Gabriel is asking Mindy exactly where in Rome he can find her.
questions: Does Gabriel actually go to Rome to fight for Emily?
Can Emily build a real life away from Paris?
Will Camille's pregnancy lie ever reach Gabriel?

characters.name: Emily Cooper
characters.line: Managing Agence Grateau's new Rome office and dating Marcello.

characters.name: Sylvie Grateau
characters.line: Expanded Grateau to Rome after her exposé of JVMA chief Louis de Leon.

characters.name: Gabriel
characters.line: Just earned his Michelin star, single, and asking Mindy where Emily is in Rome.

characters.name: Camille
characters.line: Was never actually pregnant and has hidden it from Gabriel; drifting between him and Sofia.

characters.name: Marcello Muratori
characters.line: Italian cashmere heir who has taken Emily to Rome.

characters.name: Alfie
characters.line: Broke up with Emily on the jumbotron; still working as Antoine's CFO.

characters.name: Mindy Chen
characters.line: Dating Nicholas as JVMA collapses around his family.

characters.name: Nicholas de Leon
characters.line: Mindy's boyfriend, watching his father get pushed out of JVMA after Sylvie's exposé.

beats.label: S5 · Rome and the Muratoris
beats.text: In Rome Emily takes over Sylvie's new office and dates Marcello; his mother Antonia only signed with Grateau to keep JVMA away and his sisters call Emily a gold-digger.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up that Emily's entire Rome life is running on borrowed goodwill from a family that never wanted her.

beats.label: S5 · Two quiet betrayals
beats.text: Gabriel flies to Rome hoping to find Emily and sees her kissing Marcello; back in Paris a heartbroken Mindy and lonely Alfie fall into a secret affair.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Both secrets — Gabriel's silent retreat and the Mindy-Alfie affair — are the ones the finale detonates.

beats.label: S5 · Solitano overrun
beats.text: Emily's viral marketing floods Marcello's home village of Solitano with tourists; Antonia fires Grateau, and Sylvie folds the Rome office and takes Emily back to Paris.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills the entire premise of Emily's Rome life and forces the geographical reset back to Paris.

beats.label: S5 · Home, and Nico's return
beats.text: In Paris Emily discovers the Mindy-Alfie affair and lashes out at her best friend; Nico returns having quit JVMA and his family's wealth to win Mindy back.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Mindy back in Nico's orbit while Alfie is still nursing feelings — the exact triangle the finale explodes.

beats.label: S5 · Marcello's own line
beats.text: Marcello arrives in Paris and breaks from his family to launch his own label at Venice Fashion Week, with Pierre Cadault lending an atelier and a two-week deadline.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Emily throws herself into rebuilding Marcello — the investment that makes turning down his proposal a real sacrifice.

beats.label: S5 · Venice refusal
beats.text: In Venice Emily finds an engagement ring in Marcello's bag; when he asks, she turns him down rather than move to Solitano, and they break up as his show triumphs.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the Marcello relationship and frees Emily just as everything else in Paris is unravelling.

beats.label: S5 · Paris in pieces
beats.text: Mindy accepts Nico's ring the same day, blindsiding Alfie; Princess Jane bails Grateau out of Laurent's debts, and Gabriel writes to Emily from a yacht in Greece.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The three open threads — Alfie's regret, Sylvie under a new equity partner, Gabriel's invitation — are the entire launchpad for what comes next.

cliffhanger.text: Emily is back in Paris and single, Sylvie's agency is only alive because Princess Jane has bought her way in, Mindy is engaged to Nico just as Alfie realises he loves her — and a postcard from a yacht in Greece is asking Emily to come find Gabriel.
questions: Will Mindy actually marry Nico now that Alfie has admitted his feelings?
Can Sylvie really run Grateau under Princess Jane's thumb?

characters.name: Gabriel

characters.name: Mindy Chen

characters.name: Alfie

characters.name: Marcello Muratori

characters.name: Nicholas de Leon

characters.name: Laurent Grateau

characters.name: Princess Jane
